title: FP8/INT8 calibration + profile E2E: batching & long-seq throughput/latency benchmarks
creator: Maya Chen
description: Run end-to-end benchmarks that validate FP8 (E4M3/E5M2) and INT8 calibrated variants against float32 and FP16 baselines. Focus is on how calibration profiles and runtime batching interact for long context workloads (2k-32k tokens) and on production-relevant latency/throughput metrics (p50/p90/p99, tokens/sec, cold vs warm KV cache). Include accuracy validation on representative task suites to quantify quality regressions from calibration choices.
background: We already have microbenchmarks for kernel throughput and a few calibration artifacts, but lack a standardized E2E matrix that combines: profile variant (per-channel vs per-tensor), rounding schemes, calibration dataset selection, and runtime batching strategies (static batching, continuous batching, pack/pack+pad). Recent customer repros show latency spikes when using quantized variants with large batch packing and long KV caches. We need a repeatable benchmark harness + pass/fail thresholds for release gating.
acceptance_criteria: Deliver an automated benchmark suite (CI job + harness) that runs the quantization matrix and uploads results to the performance dashboard
Establish calibration recipes (scripts + config) for FP8 and INT8 that are repeatable and published in our calibration repo
Document observed latency/throughput deltas vs baseline for A100/H100 across context lengths [512,2048,8192,32768] and batch sizes [1,4,16,64], including KV cache cold/warm scenarios
Define quality regression thresholds: relative perplexity increase <= 2% AND top-1 task accuracy drop <= 1.5% for approved calibration profiles; otherwise mark profile as experimental
Identify at least two batching/runtime mitigations when quantized variants exceed latency SLO (examples: reduce max_batch_pack, prefer shallow packing for long-context flows)
Merge a PR with the harness and one sample calibration profile per quant format (FP8-E4M3, FP8-E5M2, INT8 symmetric)
tasks: Design benchmark matrix (quant format x calib type x batch strategy x context length)
Implement CI harness that runs matrix on A100/H100 GPU worker pools
Create representative calibration dataset: 10k tokens per model, per-domain sampling (chat, summarization, code) and store calibration artifacts
Integrate accuracy checks: perplexity, Rouge-L on summarization set, and pairwise preference eval on instruction dataset
Run initial sweep, collect metrics, and upload to perf dashboard with tagged artifacts
Triage any catastrophic accuracy/latency regressions and propose runtime mitigations
benchmark_matrix_summary: Matrix includes FP32/FP16 baseline, FP8-E4M3, FP8-E5M2 (per-tensor/per-channel variants), INT8 symmetric/asymmetric (per-channel), and 3 calibration strategies (min-max, KL-divergence, MSE with per-channel stats). Runtime tests exercise: continuous batching (batch windows 4/8/16ms), static batching (max_batch 4/16/64), and pack-based batching with long-sequence padding behavior. Measurements: p50/p90/p99 latency, tokens/s, tail latency under 99th percentile of concurrent requests, memory usage, and KV cache size impact.
calibration_workflow: 1) Select representative corpora sampler per workload (chat, summarization, code, retrieval). 2) Run activation collection with batch=8, seq_len=128 on baseline FP32 model to collect per-layer activation histograms and per-channel stats. 3) Apply calibration algorithm (KL / MSE / minmax) and generate calibration JSON with scale/zero_point per tensor or per channel. 4) Validate quantized weights + activations with a held-out accuracy harness, record top-level metrics. 5) Store artifacts under s3://redwood-quant-calibs/<model>/<format>/<date>/ and tag in results. 6) Promote profile if it passes accuracy/latency gates.
accuracy_validation_plan: Run three validation suites: (A) perplexity sweep on held-out language modeling set (1k examples), (B) summarization benchmark (CNN/DM subset 200 examples) with Rouge-L and length-normalized scores, (C) instruction-following pairwise preference eval (500 pairs) to detect hallucination/regression. Compute relative deltas vs FP16 baseline and flag any metric beyond thresholds in acceptance criteria.
observability_and_artifacts: CI job must upload: raw traces (latency histograms), token-level timing breakdowns (embedding, attention, matmul kernel, kv-write/read), calibration artifacts (JSON), and a standardized CSV summary. Links to artifacts must be included in the ticket comments after runs.
risks: 1) FP8 kernel availability on H100 may require runtime kernel flag flips; missing vendor kernels could skew numbers. 2) Calibration overfit to small calibration datasets causing accuracy regressions in long-context inputs. 3) Batching interactions (packing) can cause strided memory access patterns that magnify quantization error for KV cache. 4) CI GPU quotas may limit parallelism causing long overall run times.
mitigations: Fallback to FP16 for suites where FP8 kernels are not yet validated; mark results as partial
Increase calibration corpus diversity and add per-domain holdouts to detect overfit
Add runtime experiment flags to toggle pack padding thresholds and max_batch_pack per model route
Schedule nightly CI runs and prioritize smaller representative subsets for quick feedback loops
